programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society investigate Green Lawn Cemetery in Southwest Minnesota, a site notorious for teenage “dares” and urban legends. What they uncover is much deeper than anticipated, revealing historical significance alongside paranormal activity.

programme.title: The Basement Office
programme.desc: Over the last 7 years, you’ve probably seen news headlines about multiple UFO whistleblowers who’ve come forward to claim the US government is hiding the existence of aliens and alien technology.

programme.title: Haunted...of Hollywood
programme.desc: A documentary film on some of the most haunted theaters in Hollywood, where ghosts are present. These are the ghost stores based on witnesses.

programme.title: Aliens Uncovered
programme.desc: Phoenix, Arizona wasn't supposed to be the city we know in present day. Before Area 51, hidden deep in the desert, the military discovered a hidden gem that helped them cover up the UFO wave of 1947. Roswell was not the only event that took place. Arizona was home to three major UFO events that the public hardly knows about. These events helped create Project Bluebook.

programme.title: Dark Arts TV
programme.desc: The Dark Arts TV team visits Bihl Manor in Fremont, Ohio, a 19th-century home later turned children’s group residence. Surrounded by stories of ghostly children, shadowy figures, and mysterious footsteps, the manor has earned a lasting reputation as one of the region’s most haunted sites—where the line between legend and reality may not be as distant as it seems.
